summary: All turret, attachment, projectile and beam presentation consumes the preserved art through modern model, BER and renderer pipelines.

authoritative_state: Turret aim, target, concealed state and addon inventory remain server-owned.
Client renderers derive interpolation and particles from synchronized presentation state.

flows.purpose: Consume existing bounded aim and beam presentation payloads.
validation: Client requires a loaded matching turret for aim.
Beam sampling is capped at 96 steps and RGB values are cosmetic.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: Blocks and entities retain complete gameplay without model classes.

generated: Invisible turret block models backed by BER model layers
manual: Preserved GPL-3.0-compatible turret, addon, rocket and attachment textures

budgets.measurement: One particle at each of at most 96 segments plus endpoint.

performance.measurement_environment: Java 21, NeoForge 21.1.234 client and GameTest server.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: All turret definitions map to a stable texture and model key.
criteria.observation: Rendering one block and item instance of every turret definition uses its declared model key and texture without a missing-texture fallback.

criteria.statement: Six attachment directions map to deterministic render transforms.
criteria.observation: Rendering the same turret on all six attachment faces produces the documented deterministic orientation for each face.

criteria.statement: Concealed state and addon masks derive from synchronized gameplay state.
criteria.observation: Changing synchronized concealed and addon-mask state changes only the corresponding visible turret and addon geometry.

criteria.statement: Beam sampling and cosmetic particle counts are bounded.
criteria.observation: At maximum configured beam length and during every cosmetic burst, the observed sample count never exceeds the declared beam and particle limits.

criteria.statement: Rocket flight emits 21 smoke particles without flame, while plasma has no flight trail and emits paired 16-particle flame/large-smoke impact bursts.
criteria.observation: A rocket client tick emits 21 smoke particles and no flame; plasma emits no flight particles and one impact emits 16 flame plus 16 large-smoke particles.

criteria.statement: Rail Gun and Relativistic idle dust use six particles per display tick, and a Teleporter shot emits a 26-particle portal burst at the turret.
criteria.observation: Each visible Rail Gun and Relativistic display tick emits six dust particles, and one accepted Teleporter shot emits 26 portal particles centered on the turret.

criteria.statement: No renderer or model class is loaded by a dedicated server.
criteria.observation: A dedicated server reaches its ready state without loading renderer, model, screen or other client-only visual classes.

criteria.statement: All model, texture and blockstate references resolve.
criteria.observation: The asset gate resolves every turret blockstate, model and texture reference without a missing asset.

criteria.statement: Plasma preserves the legacy Grenade Launcher model and texture reuse.
criteria.observation: The Plasma turret block and item deliberately resolve to the grenade model and grenade_turret texture used by the 1.12.2 renderer.

covers: All turret definitions map to a stable texture and model key.
Six attachment directions map to deterministic render transforms.
Concealed state and addon masks derive from synchronized gameplay state.
tests.expected: Pure visual routing rules pass without loading client classes.

covers: Beam sampling and cosmetic particle counts are bounded.
Rocket flight emits 21 smoke particles without flame, while plasma has no flight trail and emits paired 16-particle flame/large-smoke impact bursts.
Rail Gun and Relativistic idle dust use six particles per display tick, and a Teleporter shot emits a 26-particle portal burst at the turret.
No renderer or model class is loaded by a dedicated server.
All model, texture and blockstate references resolve.
Plasma preserves the legacy Grenade Launcher model and texture reuse.

steps: Place every turret on all six faces of tier-five bases.
Capture idle, aimed, firing and concealed states.
Repeat with Damage Amp, Solar Panel and Redstone Reactor.
manual_checks.expected: Placed heads retain the same texture brightness as held heads; geometry, pivot, texture, attachment and visibility match the legacy visual intent without transparent terrain holes.

steps: Place every inventory expander, power expander and loot deleter on all six faces of a compatible base.
Compare each rendered plate against its selection and collision outline.
Place and operate the manual charger on every horizontal base face and inspect its item form.
Reload client resources and inspect the manual charger item again.
manual_checks.expected: All eleven plate attachments occupy the legacy 12x12x6 side indicated by FACING, and the manual charger survives startup/resource reload using the preserved lever texture and animated two-part model rather than a fallback cube.

steps: Observe all seven projectile types and both beam turrets.
Inspect the 21-smoke rocket trail, the absence of a plasma flight trail, the paired plasma impact burst and beam colors.
Observe Rail Gun and Relativistic idle dust and fire the Teleporter once.
manual_checks.expected: The visible particle families and counts match the 1.12.2 behavior while remaining within declared budgets.
